reports.branch: Determinantal point processes, negative association, rigidity (Ghosh-Peres rigidity, Lyons DPP theory, hyperuniformity/stealth)

fit.S1: 1/5 — The branch's axioms (kernel positivity 0<=K<=1, strong Rayleigh, DLR, rigidity) are pure statistics-side and consume NO Euler-product/multiplicativity input; DH/Epstein zero ordinates satisfy every band-limited statistical property the branch can check at axiom level. Only speculative hook: primes-side 'effectively limit-periodic/stealth' structure factor (arXiv:1801.01541), which is heuristic/numerical, not an axiom-grade input.
fit.S2: 1/5 — Rigidity (Ghosh-Peres) and negative association are properties of a probability MEASURE (zero-one laws on tail sigma-algebras); for the single deterministic zero configuration they are literally undefined, and every deterministic shadow (empirical limits, hyperuniform number variance, Benjamini-Schramm averaging) erases o(N) off-line defects by construction. Even a full theorem 'rescaled zero set converges to the sine process' would NOT imply RH.
fit.S3: 3/5 — Genuine structural asset: by the functional equation an off-line zero beta+it forces 1-beta+it, so the ORDINATE multiset has a double point; hence 'ordinate point set is simple' <=> 'RH + all zeros simple'. DPPs with Hermitian locally trace-class kernels are a.s. simple — an all-order, multiplicity-visible positivity statement that lemmaR_tight-class two-moment certificates provably cannot express. No proof mechanism exists, but the reformulation is exactly S3-shaped.
fit.S4: 3/5 — The branch IS the S4 probabilistic row: 0<=K<=1 (Macchi-Soshnikov), strong Rayleigh/negative association (Borcea-Branden-Liggett JAMS 2009), and maximal rigidity via spectral gaps are positivity generators genuinely distinct from the Weil cone. But NO deterministic certificate form exists in the literature (verified by search: nobody has published 'fixed configuration satisfies checkable DPP-property X => on a line'), so the generator currently has no bridge to a fixed zero set.
fit.S5: 1/5 — The Alternative Hypothesis world (arXiv:2507.06823) is a direct kill: everything the branch can verify about zeta's zero statistics is band-limited (|alpha|<1), and AH-consistent processes match all of it; stealth/maximal-rigidity machinery (Ghosh-Lebowitz 1707.04328, Lachieze-Rey 2512.10686) requires a spectral GAP in the structure factor, which the sine/zeta form factor F(alpha)~|alpha| does not have (it vanishes only at a point).

key_objects: Ghosh-Peres number rigidity (Duke Math. J. 166 (2017) 1789-1858): number of points in a compact set a.s. determined by the exterior configuration — the conceptual template for C2's deterministic explicit-formula sum-rule systems
Macchi-Soshnikov existence characterization: Hermitian DPP exists iff 0 <= K <= 1 — a positivity interval on operators, a non-Weil positivity generator; sine kernel is a projection (extreme point)

A.s. simplicity of DPPs with locally trace-class Hermitian kernels — combined with the elementary fact that off-line zeros create double ORDINATES (rho=beta+it and 1-beta+it share ordinate t), this makes 'simple ordinate set' equivalent to RH+simplicity: the branch's only S3-visible, all-order object

Strong Rayleigh / negative association (Borcea-Branden-Liggett, JAMS 22 (2009) 521-567; arXiv:0707.2340): closed under conditioning/marginals, implies concentration — candidate inequality family on counting functionals; no number-theory application published

DLR description + rigidity + tolerance of Sine_beta (Dereudre-Hardy-Leble-Maida, arXiv:1809.03989, CPAM 2020/21): exterior configuration determines interior COUNT but not positions — Gibbsian/conservation-law reading of sine statistics

Stealthy hyperuniformity => maximal rigidity (Ghosh-Lebowitz arXiv:1707.04328) and its 2025-26 unification with uniqueness pairs / uncertainty principle (Lachieze-Rey arXiv:2512.10686) — the branch's deterministic-reconstruction machinery; requires a structure-factor gap zeta does not have, but its uncertainty-pair formulation is the same technology as the Cohn-Elkies/Fourier-duality front

Valko-Virag stochastic zeta function (arXiv:2009.04670, GAFA 2022): random analytic function with Sine_beta zeros, functional equation, Cartwright-class uniqueness — an 'RH-true' model world usable as a barrier-zoo member

Hyperuniformity of zeta zeros (Torquato school, arXiv:0809.0449 and later): CONDITIONAL on RH via Montgomery's form factor — using it as input is circular; unconditional long-range number-variance control comes only from Selberg's S(T) moments, which DH-type functions share
prior_attacks: Montgomery 1973 pair correlation + Dyson's sine-kernel identification (the branch's origin). Not a proof attempt but the canonical bridge; as a proof route it died at the bandwidth wall: F(alpha) is provable only for |alpha|<1 and the Alternative Hypothesis is consistent with ALL such data (arXiv:2507.06823, verified in program literature) — statistical verification can never certify sine structure.

LeClair-Franca statistical-mechanics/random-walk approach ('A theory for the zeros of Riemann zeta and other L-functions', arXiv:1407.4358, VERIFIED online this run): derives RH 'with probability one' from pseudo-randomness of primes (Brownian regime of S(T)). Died exactly at converting probabilistic pseudo-randomness into a deterministic statement about the fixed prime sequence — self-acknowledged heuristic, never refereed as a proof. This is the sharpest existing demonstration of the branch's S2 failure mode.

Torquato-Scardicchio-Zachary fermionic/Fermi-sphere program (arXiv:0809.0449, 2008) and the hyperuniformity-of-zeros literature: purely descriptive; hyperuniformity of zeta zeros is stated CONDITIONAL on RH — never an attack, and circular as an input.

Valko-Virag stochastic zeta (GAFA 2022) and Chhaibi-Najnudel-Nikeghbali (Inventiones 207 (2017) 23-113, VERIFIED): construct random analytic functions whose zeros are sine(-beta) processes on a line — 'RH-true' random models. Alive as model theory; dead as an attack channel because there is no arithmetic input: the zeta-side convergence statements require RH-type hypotheses, and nothing flows back from the model to zeta.

The rigidity program itself (Ghosh 2015 sine rigidity; Ghosh-Peres Duke 2017; Bufetov; Dereudre-Hardy-Leble-Maida CPAM 2020/21): NO published application to the deterministic zeta zero set was found in any search this run (2013-2026) — nobody in the branch has even attempted the deterministic-certificate step. reports.first_interface: THEOREM TARGET (determinantal ordinate-simplicity interface). (a) Define unconditionally, via the Weil explicit formula, the n-level ordinate correlation distributions rho_n^T of the rescaled zero-ordinate multiset (off-line zeros included with multiplicity; note rho = beta+i t off-line forces the distinct zero 1-beta+i t at the SAME ordinate t, so RH + all-zeros-simple is EQUIVALENT to the ordinate multiset being a simple point set). (b) Construct from the prime side a Hermitian, locally trace-class kernel K_T such that rho_n^T = det[K_T(x_i,x_j)] + E_n(T) for all n <= n_0(T), with the error E_n controlled by an Euler-product-grade input (Lambda(n) >= 0 pointwise plus multiplicativity at every prime — an input Davenport-Heilbronn violates) rather than by L2 mean values. (c) Prove the certificate step: 0 <= K_T <= 1 plus the determinantal identity to order n forces the n-th ordinate coincidence measure to vanish to explicit order — so any off-line pair or on-line multiple zero at height ~T produces a quantified NEGATIVE determinant minor, contradicting (b). Referee-evaluable milestones: (a) is checkable now at n=2, bandwidth<1 (Baluyot et al. arXiv:2306.04799); the decisive and honest sticking point is (b) beyond bandwidth 1, where the Alternative Hypothesis proves band-limited data cannot suffice — the Euler-product supply line is the ONLY admissible source, and no technique for it exists in this branch.

fit.S1: 1/5 — the axioms are pure entire-function/operator theory: DH and Epstein (h>1) inhabit the SAME classes (as indefinite/Pontryagin objects with kappa>0), so nothing in the framework consumes the Euler product at the axiom level; Lambda(n) enters only as data inside Suzuki's screw function g(t) (estimate level), and his positivity criterion is self-declared 'an analog of Weil's positivity or Li's criterion'.
fit.S2: 3/5 — the Krein-Langer negative-squares index kappa_a registers a SINGLE off-line zero by definition (kappa_a >= 1 for any zero with beta > a), but there is no computable access: compressions need dim ~ N(T) (campaign no-go 'Pontryagin negative-index counting route structurally empty'), and kappa_a < infinity is open for every a in (1/2,1) (C1 adjudication; density bounds do not bound the all-heights count).
fit.S3: 4/5 — the branch's genuine spec asset: negative squares count off-line zeros WITH multiplicity, so an on-line double (0 negative squares) is distinguished from an off-line pair (>=1) — exactly the invariant lemmaR_tight lacks, already recorded in the program (K_a kernels, B3); but it is bookkeeping, not prime-computable, and B3's verification showed the computable jet avatar does NOT separate the degenerate pair at depth 0.
fit.S4: 1/5 — every positivity target the branch has ever produced (Hermite-Biehler property, Hamiltonian H >= 0, screw-function non-positive-definiteness, Li's lambda_n >= 0, de Branges' conditions) is Weil positivity reparametrized (Bombieri-Lagarias for Li; Suzuki explicitly; H>=0 <=> HB <=> quasi-RH by construction); the single distinct sufficient-condition family (de Branges' own) was killed numerically by Conrey-Li. Only faint untested candidate for a new generator: the de Branges chain total-ordering rigidity, never made into an inequality by anyone.
fit.S5: 2/5 — Conrey-Li is a named S5 no-go aimed precisely at this branch; this program's C1 refutation (containment theorem: all prime-computable tilted/jet de Branges observables at cutoff X lie inside the classical bandwidth-log X Weil-EF data class, ghost terms ~X^{beta-a}) covers the branch's entire prime-computable sector; Pontryagin counting is empty; what survives the no-gos is structure theory, not certificates.

fit.S1: 1/5 — The branch's axioms (0<=K<=1 kernel positivity, strong Rayleigh, DLR, rigidity, stealth) are pure statistics-side and consume NO Euler-product/multiplicativity input; DH/Epstein ordinates satisfy every band-limited statistical property the branch can check at axiom level; no DPP-side theorem has a slot where Lambda(n)>=0 or multiplicativity could enter.
fit.S2: 1/5 — Rigidity and negative association are properties of a probability MEASURE (tail sigma-algebra zero-one laws); for the single deterministic zero configuration they are undefined, and every deterministic shadow (empirical limits, number-variance, Benjamini-Schramm averaging) erases o(N) off-line defects by construction; even a proven 'zeros converge to sine process' would not imply RH.
fit.S3: 3/5 — Genuine structural asset: the functional equation forces an off-line zero beta+it to pair with 1-beta+it at the SAME ordinate t, so 'ordinate multiset is a simple point set' <=> 'RH + all zeros simple'; DPPs with Hermitian locally trace-class kernels are a.s. simple — an all-order, multiplicity-visible positivity statement provably outside the two-moment lemmaR_tight class. No proof mechanism exists, but the reformulation is exactly S3-shaped.
fit.S4: 3/5 — The branch IS the S4 probabilistic row: Macchi-Soshnikov 0<=K<=1 (verified: Soshnikov, Russian Math. Surveys 55 (2000), arXiv:math/0002099), strong Rayleigh/negative association (Borcea-Branden-Liggett JAMS 2009), maximal rigidity — positivity generators genuinely distinct from the Weil cone. But NO deterministic certificate form applicable to a fixed configuration exists anywhere in the literature (absence re-confirmed online this run, 2013-2026); the only published deterministic determinant certificates (CNV 1986 Hankel-type D(n,r)>0; Nuttall 2011; GORZ Jensen hyperbolicity) are Laguerre-Polya-class reformulations of RH with no arithmetic mechanism, not DPP structure.
fit.S5: 1/5 — The Alternative Hypothesis world (arXiv:2507.06823) is a direct kill: everything the branch can verify about zeta statistics is band-limited (|alpha|<1) and AH-consistent processes match all of it; stealth/maximal-rigidity machinery requires a structure-factor GAP (Lachieze-Rey arXiv:2512.10686, verified this run: gap or cone hypotheses, no NT content) which the zeta form factor F~|alpha| does not have; the GORZ-style asymptotic-universality escape hatch reproduces exactly the density-method o(N) blindness in the shift parameter.

prior_attacks: Montgomery 1973 pair correlation + Dyson sine-kernel identification (the branch's origin). As a proof route it died at the bandwidth wall: F(alpha) provable only for |alpha|<1, and the Alternative Hypothesis is consistent with ALL such data (arXiv:2507.06823) — statistical verification can never certify sine structure.

Csordas-Norfolk-Varga 1986 (TAMS; solved Polya's 1927 Turan-inequality problem for the xi coefficients) and the derived determinant-inequality route: RH follows if Hankel-type determinants D(n,r)>0 for all r; VERIFIED this run that positivity is known only for r=1,2,3 and the general family is OPEN — died because the determinant family is an RH-strength reformulation with no arithmetic mechanism (no Euler-product input; and Rodgers-Tao Lambda>=0 means such Laguerre-Polya-class certificates have zero slack).

Nuttall, 'Determinantal approach to a proof of the Riemann hypothesis' (arXiv:1111.1128, 2011, VERIFIED this run): doubly-infinite determinant positivity => RH, extending CNV via Karlin total positivity; never refereed/published, positivity claim never proven — died at exactly the same no-mechanism wall.

Griffin-Ono-Rolen-Zagier, 'Jensen polynomials for the Riemann zeta function' (PNAS 116 (2019) 11103, arXiv:1902.07321, VERIFIED this run): RH <=> hyperbolicity of all Jensen polynomials J^{d,n}; proved for all d<=8 and, for every d, all sufficiently large shifts n via Hermite-polynomial asymptotic universality — the closest thing to a deterministic 'determinantal-class' certificate ever partially proven, and it died structurally: the GUE/Hermite universality mechanism is asymptotic-only, blind to finitely many shifts per degree (the S2 o(N)-blindness in different coordinates), and consumes no multiplicativity input.

LeClair-Franca (arXiv:1407.4358): RH 'with probability one' from pseudo-randomness of primes — died at converting probabilistic pseudo-randomness into a deterministic statement about the fixed prime sequence; self-acknowledged heuristic, never refereed as a proof. The sharpest demonstration of the branch's S2 failure mode.

Torquato-Scardicchio-Zachary Fermi-sphere/hyperuniformity program (arXiv:0809.0449 and later): purely descriptive; hyperuniformity of zeta zeros is stated CONDITIONAL on RH — never an attack, and circular as an input.

Valko-Virag stochastic zeta (GAFA 2022) and Chhaibi-Najnudel-Nikeghbali (Inventiones 207 (2017) 23-113): random analytic functions with sine(-beta) determinantal zeros on a line — alive as model theory, dead as attack channel: no arithmetic flows back from model to zeta.

reports.first_interface: THEOREM TARGET (determinantal ordinate-simplicity interface). (a) Define unconditionally, via the Weil explicit formula, the n-level ordinate correlation measures rho_n^T of the rescaled zero-ordinate multiset (off-line zeros included with multiplicity; the functional equation forces an off-line zero beta+it to pair with 1-beta+it at the same ordinate, so RH + all-zeros-simple is EQUIVALENT to the ordinate multiset being a simple point set). (b) Construct from the prime side a Hermitian, locally trace-class kernel K_T with rho_n^T = det[K_T(x_i,x_j)] + E_n(T) for all n <= n_0(T), where the error E_n is controlled by an Euler-product-grade input (Lambda(n)>=0 pointwise plus multiplicativity at every prime — inputs Davenport-Heilbronn violates), not by L2 mean values. (c) Certificate step: 0<=K_T<=1 plus the determinantal identity to order n forces the n-th ordinate coincidence measure to vanish to explicit order, so any off-line pair or on-line multiple zero at height ~T produces a quantified NEGATIVE determinant minor contradicting (b). Milestone (a)+(c) at n=2 bandwidth<1 is checkable now against arXiv:2306.04799; the honest sticking point is (b) beyond bandwidth 1, where the Alternative Hypothesis proves band-limited data cannot suffice — the Euler-product supply line is the only admissible source and no technique for it exists in this branch.

reports.branch: F1-geometry: Lambda-rings, blueprints, arithmetic site (Borger, Soule, Deitmar, Lorscheid, Connes-Consani)

fit.S1: 3/5 - Axiom-level Euler-product input genuinely present: Borger's Lambda-structure IS 'compatible Frobenius lifts at every prime' (descent to F1), and the arithmetic site's points are the adele class space, presupposing full multiplicativity - DH/Epstein admit no Lambda-structure or arithmetic-site analogue (no Euler product / no multiplicativity), so the input distinguishes zeta at the AXIOM level; but no theorem yet converts this input into zero-location leverage.
fit.S2: 2/5 - The Weil-proof-transfer strategy is intersection-theoretic hence EXACT (would see every single zero, unlike density methods), so in-principle S2-perfect; but the enabling object (cohomology + intersection theory on the square) provably does not exist yet in any formalism (verified against Connes' own essay and the June 2026 paper).
fit.S3: 2/5 - Intersection multiplicities in a completed Weil-style proof count zeros WITH multiplicity (function-field precedent), and Meyer's spectral realization carries multiplicity data; but nothing existing in the branch distinguishes an on-line double from an off-line pair today.
fit.S4: 3/5 - The branch is the only one squarely on S4's ALGEBRAIC row (Hodge index/ampleness - the sole mechanism that ever proved an RH, via Weil/Deligne); however its own stated closing inequality (dim H^0(D)+dim H^0(-D) >= (1/2)D.D with D.D<0) is the Weil explicit-formula positivity restated geometrically - the generator is a target, not a theorem, and as of today the route terminates on Weil positivity in new clothes.
fit.S5: 2/5 - Structurally immune to AH-world, bandwidth/two-moment ceilings, Bombieri-Garrett, parity, and mollifier limits (it is not a density/certificate/sieve method); but its final step sits exactly on the campaign's mine 'every route's substantive step was Weil positivity in disguise' - here openly, as the LAST step - and Bombieri's small-support result marks precisely where the cone must grow for content to appear.

Connes 1999, 'Trace formula in noncommutative geometry and the zeros of the Riemann zeta function' (Selecta 5; math/9811068) - explicit formula = trace formula on the adele class space; RH reduced to validity of the global trace formula. DIED AS A PROOF ROUTE: the global (Hilbert-space, positivity-carrying) trace formula is RH-equivalent, so no independent traction; the semilocal version is proven but RH-empty. [abstract verified online]

Meyer 2005, 'On a representation of the idele class group related to primes and zeros of L-functions' (Duke 127; math/0311468) - UNCONDITIONAL Lefschetz-style spectral realization of the Weil explicit formula on a bornological space. Not an attack that died but the branch's decisive internal NO-GO: it proves a Lefschetz fixed-point formula for the Frobenius flow EXISTS without RH, so the answer to this brief's headline question is 'yes, and it is provably RH-empty' - all RH content is in the positivity/Hodge structure the realization lacks. [verified online]

Alive as combinatorics/representation theory only. [verified online]

Connes-Consani 2014-2026, arithmetic/scaling-site Riemann-Roch strategy (arXiv:1405.4527, 1507.05818, 1805.10501, 2205.01391, Lincei 2024, JNCG 2026, 2606.06604) - THE ONLY LIVE F1 ATTACK. Precise stall, stated by Connes himself (essay arXiv:1509.05576, sec. 4.3.2): 'What is missing is an intersection theory and a Riemann-Roch theorem on the square of the arithmetic site'; tropical RR 'is limited to curves and there is no Serre duality or good cohomological version of H^j for j != 0'; the closing step needs dim H^0(D)+dim H^0(-D) >= (1/2)D.D and D.D < 0 - i.e. a Hodge-index inequality which IS Weil positivity, attacked directly (archimedean place only) in Selecta 2021 (arXiv:2006.13771); semilocal open. reports.first_interface: CHECKPOINT THEOREM (positivity-free, referee-evaluable): On the square of the scaling site - equivalently on X-bar x_{F1} X-bar for the absolute arithmetic curve X-bar of arXiv:2606.06604 - construct an intersection pairing on Frobenius-flow-invariant divisor classes, compatible with the integer-dimensional cohomology H^0(D) and Serre duality of Connes-Consani 'Riemann-Roch for Spec Z-bar' (Bull. Sci. Math. 2023) and with the Jacobian of arXiv:2602.15941, such that for every admissible test function f the pairing of the diagonal Delta with the f-weighted Frobenius correspondence integral of Psi_lambda f(lambda) d*lambda equals the Weil explicit-formula distribution W(f) exactly (prime terms = periodic-orbit local contributions, archimedean term = complex-Tate-curve orbit contribution). This is Connes' own named missing step ('an intersection theory and a Riemann-Roch theorem on the square of the arithmetic site') made precise, and it is decidable by a referee WITHOUT touching RH. The RH-deciding sequel - the Hodge-index inequality dim H^0(D) + dim H^0(-D) >= (1/2) D.D with D.D < 0 for deg D > 0, valid on a divisor cone strictly larger than the image of Bombieri's small-support test functions (supp inside (1/p, p)) - must then be flagged under S4 as Weil positivity in geometric coordinates unless the ampleness/theta-divisor structure of the Jacobian supplies an independent algebraic proof; the interface contract should REQUIRE that any positivity claim identify which geometric input (ampleness of a theta divisor on Pic(Spec Z-bar)) replaces the analytic positivity assumption.

reports.first_interface: TARGET THEOREM (Arithmetic Castelnuovo for the absolute square). Let C = (Spec Z)_F1 be the Connes-Consani absolute arithmetic curve (arXiv:2606.06604), with Pic(C) as in arXiv:2602.15941 and Riemann-Roch as in arXiv:2306.00456/2205.01391. Construct the fibered square S = C x_F1 C together with: (i) a correspondence group Corr(S) containing the diagonal Delta, the two fibers xi_1, xi_2, and the graphs Psi_lambda of the scaling-site Frobenius correspondences, closed under composition and transpose; (ii) a symmetric biadditive R-valued intersection pairing on Corr(S) such that for test elements Psi_f = integral of f(lambda) Psi_lambda d*lambda the number (Psi_f . Delta) equals the Weil explicit-formula distribution W(f) — i.e. the explicit formula becomes an intersection-number computation (this alone is the referee-evaluable Milestone 1, generalizing the scaling-site periodic-orbit RR); and (iii) a Hodge-index inequality — the pairing is negative semidefinite on the subgroup of correspondences trivial against xi_1 and xi_2 — whose proof consumes ONLY the RR theorem on S plus theta-effectivity (h^0_theta(D) >= deg D + O(1), Bost/van der Geer-Schoof) via the Mattuck-Tate argument, and which specializes, under degeneration of C to a curve over F_q, to the classical Castelnuovo-Severi inequality (non-circularity clause: in that specialization the index theorem is provably independent of RH). Conclusion by Weil's argument: every zero of zeta on the line, with multiplicities read off from (Psi_f^n . Delta). DH/Epstein filter at the axiom level: Corr(S) exists only because Spec Z is a genuine F1-curve with one Frobenius per prime; Davenport-Heilbronn and class-number->1 Epstein zetas admit no such curve, so the hypothesis set cannot be instantiated on them.

reports.branch: fourier-duality-crystalline (Fourier optimization / interpolation / crystalline measures & Fourier quasicrystals)

fit.S1: 1/5 — The branch's working machinery consumes only functional-equation + meromorphic-continuation axioms: the BRS interpolation duality holds for general Dirichlet series with FE (DH passes, so the filter fails at axiom level); the one Euler-grade hook the framing exposes (prime-side spectrum positivity, Λ(n)≥0 pointwise — which DH violates) is used by NO theorem in the branch.
fit.S2: 2/5 — In principle maximal: 'support is real' / real-rootedness is destroyed by a SINGLE off-line zero, so FQ/crystalline rigidity is infinitely o(N)-sensitive — but no rigidity theorem reaches zeta's class (log-growing zero density, exponentially growing prime-side mass), so the sensitivity cannot currently be brought to bear.
fit.S3: 3/5 — Multiplicity is native: FQ classifications work with divisors and integer masses (Alon-Cohen-Vinzant unit/integer-mass theorems), so an on-line double (mass 2) vs off-line pair are genuinely different objects in this language — the best S3 story of any analytic branch, but again only inside the translation-bounded class zeta is not in.
fit.S4: 2/5 — Cohn-Elkies/Fourier-optimization is structurally a sign-constrained LP cone paired with the explicit formula, i.e., a reparametrized/bigger Weil cone (exactly what S4 bans); the redeeming asset is the proven FQ ⟺ Lee-Yang equivalence (Kurasov-Sarnak, Olevskii-Ulanovskii, ACV, AKKV Inventiones 2024) — a real bridge to the sanctioned Lee-Yang analytic generator, but the bridge stops short of zeta.
fit.S5: 1/5 — The branch's own completed classification functions as a no-go: the explicit-formula pair is NOT a Fourier quasicrystal even under RH (prime-side measure Σ Λ(n)δ_{log n} has exponentially growing local mass; zero density grows), so zeta sits outside every rigidity theorem; the LP sub-branch inherits bandwidth-type ceilings and is density-blind; nothing separates the AH world.

key_objects: Lee-Yang ⟺ Fourier-quasicrystal equivalence: every FQ with unit (resp. positive-integer) masses is the divisor of a real-rooted exponential/trigonometric polynomial, i.e., a Lee-Yang restriction (Olevskii-Ulanovskii CRAS 2020; Alon-Cohen-Vinzant JFA 2023; Alon-Kummer-Kurasov-Vinzant, Inventiones 2024) — the branch's genuine rigidity engine and its bridge to S4's sanctioned Lee-Yang generator class

Bondarenko-Radchenko-Seip interpolation duality: Fourier interpolation bases from nontrivial zeros of zeta/L-functions + log-integer nodes, with a general duality principle for Dirichlet-series kernels with FE (Constr. Approx. 57 (2023) 405-461; arXiv:2005.02996) — unconditional, hence RH-insensitive

The unexploited S1 hook: the prime-side measure Σ Λ(n)δ_{±log n} is NONNEGATIVE (Λ(n) ≥ 0 pointwise — DH violates this), i.e., the explicit-formula pair is a 'positive-spectrum' summation pair; positivity-side rigidity (Favorov 2404.15448, Boyvalenkov-Favorov 2503.19567) is the only branch frontier aimed at that axiom

reports.first_interface: Positive-spectrum crystalline rigidity theorem (the branch's only non-circular route to S1): Let ν = Σ_{n≥2} c_n δ_{log n} with c_n ≥ 0 (this pointwise nonnegativity is the axiom Davenport-Heilbronn VIOLATES), c_n = O(log n), and suppose there exists an even tempered distribution σ on R with σ̂ = ν + ν∘(-id) + W_∞ (W_∞ the archimedean/FE term) and counting growth |σ|([-T,T]) = O(T log T). PROVE (or refute by explicit counterexample): if additionally the c_n are supported on prime powers of a Beurling system with c_{p^k} = log p (Euler axiom), then σ is a nonnegative atomic MEASURE on R — i.e., extend the Olevskii-Ulanovskii/Alon-Cohen-Vinzant rigidity from translation-bounded Fourier quasicrystals to spectra of exponentially growing local mass under the positivity axiom. Referee-evaluable first milestone: decide the statement for Beurling systems with a planted off-line zero pair — the theorem must fail when c_n ≥ 0 is dropped (DH realizes the failure) and must exclude the planted pair when it holds; by Arias de Reyna's equivalence (arXiv:2402.10604), the full statement specialized to ζ is RH, so any unconditional progress must be graded by how much of the exponential-growth gap beyond Boyvalenkov-Favorov (arXiv:2503.19567) it closes.

Fix omega_0 in (1/2,1). Prove exactly one of: (i) [construction] there is an unconditional, explicit, trace-normed Hamiltonian H_{omega_0}(t) whose entries at parameter t are determined by the finite prime data {Lambda(n): n <= e^{ct}} for an absolute constant c, whose canonical system realizes Suzuki's Theta_{omega_0}, and such that quasi-RH(omega_0) is equivalent to the POINTWISE 2x2 condition H_{omega_0}(t) >= 0 for all t — a local positivity format structurally different from the global Weil cone (RH itself = this statement for all omega_0 > 1/2); or (ii) [containment no-go, extending C1's adjudicated delimitation theorem to inverse-spectral coordinates] every prime-computable realization of the entries of any such Hamiltonian at cutoff X is a functional of the classical bandwidth-log X Weil-explicit-formula data class, so pointwise Hamiltonian positivity at prime-computable cutoffs carries no information beyond the Weil cone — retiring the branch's last unclaimed sector by theorem. reports.branch: Noncommutative geometry: adele class space, prolate operators (Connes / Connes-Consani / Connes-Consani-Moscovici; Bost-Connes)

fit.S1: 3 - Architecture is Euler-product-native at the axiom level (adele class space, BC system, primes enter the semilocal Weil form one at a time at supp [1/p,p]; DH/Epstein have no adelic avatar), but the two missing theorems of the live strategy (ground-state simplicity, prolate approximation) have no identified step that fails for DH - the E-map E(f)(x)=x^{1/2} sum_n f(nx) uses ALL integers (functional-equation-grade input), so axiom-level discrimination is unproven exactly where it matters.
fit.S2: 3 - Weil positivity and the conjectured spectral convergence are each broken by a single off-line zero in principle (equivalence-grade sensitivity), but every PROVEN result in the branch (archimedean positivity, zeta-cycles Theorem 1.1 which realizes only ON-line zeros, Meyer's unconditional realization of all zeros) is structurally blind to off-line zeros.
fit.S3: 2 - The Weil-form signature is multiplicity-blind (the program's own lemmaR_tight finding applies verbatim); det_reg(D_log - z) -> Xi would carry multiplicity but only at the conjectural-convergence level; no proven multiplicity-visible mechanism exists in the branch.
fit.S4: 3 - The one genuinely new PROVEN generator: Tr(theta(g) S theta(g)*) >= 0 (operator positivity of the scaling action compressed to Sonin space, CC Selecta 2021 Theorem 1) DERIVES archimedean Weil positivity rather than assuming it - a real analytic-class generator, not a Weil-cone reparametrization. But the published quantities (Fuchs 1964 e^{-4 pi lambda^2} prolate-leakage law; CCM 2511.22755 Fig. 4 overlaying log eps_lambda with log(1-chi(lambda))) show the generator's margin collapses exponentially exactly at the semilocal step where primes enter; to date it generates nothing beyond Bombieri small-support, and the post-2023 pivot replaces generator-growth with an approximation problem that is not a positivity generator at all.
fit.S5: 2 - Every proven positivity result in the branch currently sits inside the Bombieri small-support no-go zone (the campaign's own interval-arithmetic certification on [1/3,3], primes 2,3,5,7, was judged RH-content-nil by its own author); Meyer 2005 is a branch-internal no-go showing spectral realization alone has zero RH content; the convergence escape route is untested against the AH world, and its finite-dimensional truncations are exactly bandwidth-limited data.

Prolate wave operator PW_lambda = -d/dx((lambda^2-x^2)d/dx) + (2 pi lambda x)^2 and Slepian pair-of-projections (P_lambda, P^_lambda) theory; Fuchs 1964 Theorem 1 leakage law 1-chi(lambda) ~ (2^14/3) sqrt2 pi^5 e^{-4 pi lambda^2 + 9 log lambda} - the published quantity behind the campaign's e^{-4 pi X} margin law (X identified as mu = lambda^2)

The prolate ground-state guess k_lambda = E(h_lambda), h_lambda = combination of prolate functions h_{0,lambda}, h_{4,lambda} with vanishing integral, with proven O(lambda^{-2}) uniform approximation to the Hermite pair (Meixner-Schafke Satz 9) and proven Mellin/Fourier convergence of k_lambda-hat to Riemann Xi on substrips (CCM 2511.22755 Lemmas 7.1-7.3)

prior_attacks: Bost-Connes 1995 (Selecta Math 1, 411-457): quantum statistical system with zeta as partition function, spontaneous symmetry breaking, class-field-theoretic vacuum states. Never an RH attack: no positivity or zero-location mechanism was ever derived from it; alive only as structural background feeding Connes 1999. VERIFIED (nLab/secondary + citation trail).

Connes 1999, 'Trace formula in noncommutative geometry and the zeros of the Riemann zeta function' (Selecta Math 5, 29-106): spectral interpretation of critical zeros as absorption spectrum on the adele class space; the explicit formula becomes a trace formula. DIED AS PROOF ROUTE: the paper reduces RH to the validity of the global trace formula, which is EQUIVALENT to Weil positivity - a reformulation, not a decision procedure (S4 circularity); only the semilocal trace formula is proven. VERIFIED at abstract/secondary level (Springer/EuDML); fine-grained equivalence statement is recalled (see recalled_unverified).

Meyer 2005, 'A spectral interpretation for the zeros of the Riemann zeta function' (math/0412277, Gottingen seminars 2005): on nuclear Frechet spaces of the adele class space, ALL zeros (on- and off-line) contribute to an unconditional trace formula. WHERE IT CUTS: proves the spectral interpretation itself carries zero RH content - RH re-emerges exactly as a positivity/Hilbert-space question; kills every 'spectral realization suffices' version of the branch. VERIFIED (search + abstract).

Connes-Consani 2020-21, 'Weil positivity and trace formula, the archimedean place' (arXiv:2006.13771, Selecta 2021): PROVES unconditional archimedean Weil positivity for supp g in [2^{-1/2},2^{1/2}] via Sonin-space compression + prolate functions + Toeplitz control (constant c in (13,17)). STILL ALIVE as a partial theorem; blocked at the semilocal extension: the Sonin margin decays like the prolate leakage e^{-4 pi lambda^2} while prime terms of fixed size log p enter at supp [1/p,p] - the generator cannot out-margin the primes at the estimate level. VERIFIED (read from PDF).

Connes-Moscovici 2021-22, 'The UV prolate spectrum matches the zeros of zeta' (arXiv:2112.05500, PNAS 2022): negative spectrum of the prolate operator on Sonin space reproduces UV behavior of squares of zeta zeros. Spectral evidence only; no positivity, no RH claim. VERIFIED (abstract).

Connes-Consani 2021-23, 'Spectral triples and zeta-cycles' (arXiv:2106.01715, Enseign. Math. 69 (2023)): Theorem 1.1 proven - zeta-cycles realize exactly the CRITICAL-LINE zeros; first 31 zeros reproduced numerically; very small Weil-form eigenvalues (Figures 18-21, exponential in mu = lambda^2) explained by prolate near-intersection of (P_lambda, P^_lambda). WHERE IT STOPS: realizes on-line zeros only - off-line zeros invisible, so no RH content by itself. VERIFIED (read from PDF).

Connes-Consani-Moscovici 2023-24, 'Zeta zeros and prolate wave operators' (arXiv:2310.18423, Ann. Funct. Anal. 15 (2024) Paper 87, AOFA 2025 best-paper award): semilocal prolate operator unifying IR spectral realization and UV Sonin behavior; Sonin stability under adding finite places. Operator-theoretic results only; the positivity gap is NOT addressed. VERIFIED (abstract + award via JHU/Consani publication list).

Connes-Consani-Moscovici 2025, 'Zeta spectral triples' (arXiv:2511.22755, EMS forthcoming) + Connes survey 2026, 'The Riemann Hypothesis: Past, Present and a Letter Through Time' (arXiv:2602.04022): the LIVE strategy - self-adjoint rank-one perturbations whose spectra numerically converge to zeta zeros; Section 8 names the exact missing steps: (a) simplicity + evenness of the Weil-form ground state ksi_lambda, (b) rigorous prolate approximation k_lambda ~ ksi_lambda; authors state a rigorous convergence proof would establish RH and concede 'it remains possible that our strategy will face significant obstacles'. reports.first_interface: THEOREM (prolate ground-state approximation with DH discrimination; = CCM 2511.22755 missing steps (a)+(b) made quantitative, plus the S1 axiom test). Fix lambda >= lambda_0 and let QW_lambda be the Weil quadratic form of zeta restricted to the (2N+1)-dimensional space E_N(lambda) spanned by the eigenfunctions of the periodic scaling operator on [lambda^{-1}, lambda] (CCM 2511.22755, Section 1). Prove: (a) the smallest eigenvalue eps_lambda of QW_lambda is simple and its eigenvector ksi_lambda is even under u -> u^{-1}; (b) with k_lambda = E(h_lambda) the prolate-built vector of CCM Section 7, one has ||ksi_lambda - c k_lambda|| = O(lambda^{-2}) ||ksi_lambda|| for a scalar c, and the two-sided margin law e^{-4 pi lambda^2 - C log lambda} <= eps_lambda <= e^{-4 pi lambda^2 + C log lambda} (Fuchs rate); (c) [DH filter, axiom-level] the analogous approximation statement (b) FAILS for the Davenport-Heilbronn quadratic form built from the same construction with DH coefficients replacing Lambda(n) - thereby locating the exact step at which the Euler product, and not merely the functional equation, is consumed. By CCM Sections 7-8, (a)+(b) justify the convergence of spec D_log^{(lambda,N)} to the zeros of zeta(1/2+is) as N, lambda -> infinity, which establishes RH; conversely, a proof of (a)+(b) WITHOUT any step that breaks for DH would prove the strategy incomplete as stated.

reports.branch: random-matrix-moments (RMT beyond pair correlation: Keating-Snaith moments, CFKRS recipe, ratios conjectures, FHK maxima, n-level correlations)

fit.S1: 2/5 — moment technology genuinely consumes multiplicativity (amplifiers, prime Dirichlet polynomials, the arithmetic factor a_k as an Euler product) but only at the ESTIMATE level; the CUE/CbetaE model itself contains no primes and the a_k factor is glued on by a heuristic recipe (verified: Keating-Snaith CMP 2000 splits c_k = a_k·f_k with a_k inserted by hand), so nothing here excludes DH/Epstein at the axiom level.
fit.S2: 1/5 — the branch's classically maximal payoff is Lindelöf (verified: LH is EQUIVALENT to I_k << T^{1+eps} for all k, and LH does not imply RH); Lindelöf yields only o(log T)-per-window zero-density control, and all correlation/maxima statistics are density-normalized — a single off-line zero contributes O(1/N) and is invisible. Structural, not contingent.
fit.S3: 2/5 — third and higher correlations ARE in principle multiplicity-sensitive (exactly the tr R³ functional the program's merged A2/A4 cubic certificate needs to break lemmaR_tight's on-line-double ≡ off-line-pair degeneracy), but RMT supplies only the conjectural target values; the proven zeta regime (Rudnick-Sarnak, Fourier support Σ|ξ|<2) is band-limited and AH-degenerate.
fit.S4: 1/5 — no new positivity generator: the CUE determinantal/negative-association structure belongs to the already-scouted determinantal-rigidity branch (verdict instrument 0.75); the CFKRS/ratios formalism generates identities and asymptotics, not positivity.
fit.S5: 1/5 — dies precisely on the named no-gos: the Alternative Hypothesis world matches all band-limited RMT data (arXiv:2507.06823, in program files); the only RMT object that would kill AH is the ratios conjecture at full strength, which is itself conjectural, proven only in restricted shift ranges conditionally on GRH, and near-circular as an RH input.

fit.S1: 3 — An axiom-level DH-violating input exists in principle: 'zeta is the scattering determinant of an arithmetic hyperbolic surface' (Davenport-Heilbronn/Epstein functions have no such automorphic/dynamical realization), but no theorem in the branch consumes that input toward on-line-ness; it is only used to build the encoding.
fit.S2: 3 — The Mayer Fredholm-determinant encoding Z(s)=det(1-L_s)det(1+L_s) is exact and would register a SINGLE off-line zero as a single scattering resonance off the line; however every proof tool the branch owns (Perron-Frobenius, Dolgopyat spectral gaps, resonance-density/band results) delivers strips or density statements, never full-line rigidity.
fit.S3: 3 — Fredholm determinants are analytic and carry multiplicities, so an on-line double zero vs an off-line pair are distinguishable in the zero set in principle; no branch tool exploits this, and the Selberg trace formula treats the scattering channel only through -phi'/phi where the distinction washes out.
fit.S4: 1 — This is the fatal row. The branch's only positivity mechanisms are (a) self-adjointness of the hyperbolic Laplacian, which forces ONLY the Maass cusp-form zeros onto the line (the Riemann zeros sit in the non-self-adjoint scattering/continuous-spectrum channel where it gives nothing), and (b) Perron-Frobenius positivity at real temperature (thermodynamic facts only). The Fraczek-Mayer character-deformation experiments show determinant-of-nuclear-operator structure alone does NOT force zeros onto lines (lambda=+1 zeros move off under deformation). Dolgopyat/UNI cancellation is a genuinely non-Weil generator but structurally yields only resonance-free STRIPS (zero-free-region strength), never the line.
fit.S5: 2 — The natural repair inside the branch — spectralize the scattering zeros via pseudo-Laplacian self-adjoint extensions (Lax-Phillips/Colin de Verdiere move) — is exactly what Bombieri-Garrett caps at ~94% (arXiv:2002.07929, already in the program's no-go list). The encoding itself survives the AH world (it is exact), but the branch's provable outputs do not engage any of the named ceilings.

reports.first_interface: Fix the even/odd Mayer operators L_s^± of the Gauss map, whose Fredholm determinants factor Z_{PSL(2,Z)}(s) and whose non-spectral zeros encode the Riemann zeros through the scattering factor (phi(s)=xi(2s-1)/xi(2s)). THEOREM TARGET: construct a sesquilinear form Q_s on the eigenvalue-1 spectral data of L_s^+, built from Hecke-operator positivity or Rankin-Selberg nonnegativity (inputs Davenport-Heilbronn functions violate at the axiom level), with the three properties: (i) [rigidity] if Q_s ⪰ 0 for all 0 < Re(s) < 1/2, then det(1+L_s) has no non-spectral zeros off Re(s)=1/4 — equivalently RH; (ii) [non-circularity certificate] Q_s ⪰ 0 is verifiable on the cusp-form (lambda=-1) branch unconditionally, i.e. it re-proves the known on-line theorem for Maass zeros without invoking self-adjointness of the Laplacian; (iii) [DH-filter certificate] the construction of Q_s provably FAILS for the Fraczek-Mayer character-deformed family Z(s, chi_alpha) on Gamma_0(4) with chi_alpha nontrivial (where off-line zeros are numerically observed), with the failure traced to loss of the Hecke/Euler-product axiom. Property (iii) makes the proposal referee-falsifiable at design time against a concrete RH-false lookalike living INSIDE the same operator family — the exact S1/S5 discipline the spec demands. (Honest assessment: no candidate Q_s is known; Bombieri-Garrett caps the pseudo-Laplacian route to (i) at ~94%, so Q_s must not be a spectralization in disguise.)

fit.S1: 4 — Axiom-level pass of the DH/Epstein filter: the branch input is 'there exists a foliated dynamical system whose closed orbits ARE the primes with lengths log p' (Euler product = orbit product, an axiom, not an estimate; DH/Epstein lack Euler products hence any orbit space); but for zeta this axiom is so far realized only at the point-set/orbit level (Deninger 2024), not at the cohomological level where it would bite.
fit.S2: 5 — The mechanism is an identity (zeta = regularized det of (s−Θ)/2π on H^1_dyn), so every single zero is an eigenvalue of Θ; no density/proportion blindness anywhere in the formalism.
fit.S3: 4 — Zeros appear as Θ-eigenvalues WITH multiplicity on H^1_dyn: an on-line double (one eigenvalue, multiplicity 2) is structurally distinct from an off-line pair (two distinct eigenvalues off the line); capped at 4 because no computable instance of H^1_dyn exists for any number field.
fit.S4: 3 — Generator is sanctioned-algebraic (leafwise Hodge-*/Kähler identities forcing Θ = 1/2 + skew; verified in Deninger math/0505354, incl. Thm 4.1 proving it in Riemannian-foliated 3-manifold models — same mechanism class as Weil/Deligne). BUT if the scalar product on H^1_dyn is ASSUMED rather than derived from a constructed space, it is exactly Weil positivity in disguise (the campaign's known failure signature). Deninger states in print that the conformal-metric mechanism 'will not exist for dynamical systems relevant to number fields' (Kähler identities on cohomology needed) and that leafwise Hodge decomposition FAILS for non-Riemannian foliations (Deninger–Singhof counterexample). Non-circular only once the space exists.
fit.S5: 4 — Identity-based, not statistical: AH-world, bandwidth/two-moment ceilings, parity, and mollifier limits structurally do not apply; Θ is not a pseudo-Laplacian on an automorphic space, so the Bombieri–Garrett 94% cap does not directly bind. The route is blocked by its own 30-year existence problem (the space), not by any named no-go — which is also why it cannot currently decide anything.

Math. 2024, building on Kucharczyk–Scholze): constructs a genuine dynamical system per arithmetic scheme with the CORRECT closed-orbit structure (orbits ↔ closed points, lengths log N(x)). Where it stands: the system is an infinite-dimensional ringed-space construction with no compact-manifold-like structure, no defined reduced leafwise cohomology with Hodge theory, and no trace formula — the cohomological program has not been transplanted onto it. ALIVE as a construction site; not yet an attack that could die.

reports.first_interface: Theorem (target interface, referee-evaluable): Let X = X(Spec o_K) be Deninger's dynamical system constructed via rational Witt spaces (Indag. Math. 2024, arXiv:1807.06400). Define a reduced leafwise-type cohomology H-bar^i(X) (as a topological R-vector space with induced flow phi_t*) for which BOTH of the following hold: (i) [trace formula = explicit formula] the distributional Lefschetz trace sum_i (−1)^i Tr(phi* | H-bar^i(X)) exists as a distribution on R_{>0} and equals sum_p log(Np) sum_{k≥1} delta_{k log Np} + (archimedean fixed-point terms), i.e. the geometric side of the Weil explicit formula for zeta_K; and (ii) [Hodge structure] H-bar^1(X) carries a positive-definite scalar product coming from a leafwise Kähler-type *-operator with the scaling identity Θ∘* = *∘(1−Θ). Any construction achieving (i) alone would already be the first cohomological derivation of the explicit formula from a space and would pass the S1 filter at the axiom level (DH/Epstein admit no such space); (i)+(ii) together imply Θ = 1/2 + skew on H-bar^1, i.e. RH for zeta_K, by Deninger's verified argument. Honest calibration: (ii) assumed without a construction is Weil positivity restated, so the interface's substantive content is (i) plus deriving (ii) from geometry — the model-world versions of both are now proven (arXiv:2402.06671, arXiv:2410.20758), and the concrete first step is transplanting the Álvarez López–Kordyukov–Leichtnam conormal-current trace-formula framework from smooth codim-1 foliated manifolds to Deninger's non-manifold Witt space for Spec Z, or proving a no-go that it cannot be transplanted.

reports.first_interface: Interface Theorem (open; this is what would have to be true for the branch to touch RH — stated so a referee can locate the obstruction): There exist a prime p, an affinoid neighborhood W in weight space W = Hom_cont(Z_p^x, C_p^x), and a rigid-analytic family L_p on W with (i) interpolation at a Zariski-dense set of arithmetic points kappa_k in W against completed-zeta values xi(s_k) with explicit period factors, where the archimedean shadows s_k accumulate at some s* = 1/2 + it*, t* real nonzero; (ii) S1: the family exists iff the input Dirichlet series has an Euler product underlying a Galois representation (and provably fails to exist for the Davenport-Heilbronn function, whose Hurwitz-zeta constituents admit interpolation but no main-conjecture structure); (iii) S3: the lambda-invariant of the local branch of L_p at kappa* equals the multiplicity of s* as a zero of xi; (iv) S2/S4: mu >= 1 at kappa* is incompatible with Re(s*) = 1/2, so mu=0 (Ferrero-Washington-type integrality) forces the zero onto the line. KNOWN STRUCTURAL OBSTRUCTION any proof must overcome (and the precise reason the branch is scored dead): the Amice/Mellin transform of a p-adic measure on Z_p^x sees exactly the continuous p-adic characters, whose archimedean shadows are the integers; the points 1/2+it with t real nonzero are not p-adic characters, and NO sequence of arithmetic points in weight space has archimedean shadows accumulating at them — the p-adic and archimedean topologies on the s-line are transverse away from the interpolation integers, which is why every known transfer (trivial-zero L-invariant formulas, p-converse at the central point) lives on the interpolation locus and nowhere else.

fit.S1: 1/5 — Free probability proper consumes zero multiplicativity input; the finite-free/heat-flow machinery applies to arbitrary Laguerre-Pólya-type entire functions and would process an RH-false lookalike identically; the only Euler-product usage at the branch boundary (Bost-Connes partition function, CCM zeta-spectral-triple rank-one perturbations by Euler products) belongs to the NCG branch, not freeness.
fit.S2: 0/5 — Every freeness statement about zeros is an asymptotic global root-distribution/universality statement (Cauchy limit of Jensen roots, cosine universality of high derivatives, semicircle heat-flow limits); all hold regardless of finitely many exceptional zeros — structurally blind to a single off-line zero.
fit.S3: 1/5 — Differentiation/heat flows interact with root multiplicity in controlled ways at finite degree, but all proven theorems are measure-level limits in which multiplicities vanish; no multiplicity-visible invariant exists in the branch.
fit.S4: 2/5 — Two genuine positivity technologies exist: (a) real-rootedness/interlacing preservation under finite free convolution (MSS line) — a real combinatorial-class generator, but it PRESERVES rather than CREATES hyperbolicity, and Rodgers-Tao Λ>=0 (no margin below criticality) makes preservation-only arguments structurally insufficient for ξ; (b) tracial sums-of-squares Positivstellensätze — but post-MIP*=RE the general trace-positivity cone is undecidable, and any encoding of the explicit-formula functional is Weil positivity in disguise.
fit.S5: 1/5 — The branch's only zeta-facing route (Jensen hyperbolicity / heat flow) already carries a named no-go (Farmer arXiv:2008.07206) plus the Λ>=0 no-margin wall; nothing in the branch addresses AH-world, parity, or the bandwidth ceilings.

reports.first_interface: THEOREM (target interface; the only referee-evaluable bridge this branch offers): Let (W_rat(Spec Z), φ_t) be Deninger's dynamical system (arXiv:1807.06400). Construct (i) a flow-equivariant leafwise cohomology H•, finite-rank-graded in a suitable sense, whose Lefschetz-Guillemin trace formula for φ_t reproduces the Weil explicit formula for ξ term by term — with the archimedean term arising as the fixed-point contribution and the prime-p orbit terms carrying Λ(p^k) ≥ 0 as intersection multiplicities (this is where the Euler product enters at the AXIOM level: the construction must provably FAIL for Davenport-Heilbronn, which admits no such orbit structure since it has no Euler product); and (ii) an intrinsically defined transverse pairing of arithmetic-height-pairing type (Gillet-Soulé ampleness, NOT a postulated inner product) for which the flow generator Θ on H^1 satisfies Θ + Θ* = 1. Then every zero ρ of ξ has Re ρ = 1/2, with analytic multiplicity equal to the eigenvalue multiplicity of Θ (S2+S3). Referee test for non-circularity per S4: clause (ii) must be a proved consequence of an ampleness/index theorem on the constructed space; if it is assumed, the statement is Weil positivity in disguise and worthless. Honest assessment: no part of (i) or (ii) currently exists; this interface is identical in substance to the Deninger-Weil-étale scout's target — the motives branch contributes only the weight-purity axiom package and the height-pairing positivity blueprint to it.

fit.S1: 4/5 — The branch pinpoints the exact S1-grade axiom that powered the only proofs ever: coefficient nonnegativity of -log D_k for even tensor/symmetric powers (Rankin-Selberg squares) — Deligne's actual engine, and (via Kim-Sarnak) the engine that shrinks Selberg's exceptional real zeros. DH/Epstein sit in no functorial tower and admit no such square, so this input passes the DH filter at the AXIOM level; but the branch supplies no zeta-side theorem consuming it.
fit.S2: 3/5 — Anatomy shows exactly what sees a single exception in the true cases: zeros are eigenvalues of ONE operator pinned by a closed (not open/estimate) positivity condition; and it supplies the negative calibration — even in the best random ensemble only ~69% of d-regular graphs are Ramanujan (Huang-McKenzie-Yau, verified), i.e. ensemble/density methods cap strictly below 1 even in the toy world where RH is decidable. Diagnosis, not mechanism, for zeta.
fit.S3: 4/5 — In every cohomological true case multiplicity-visibility is automatic (zero multiplicity = eigenvalue multiplicity of a single operator), and the Goss/ultrametric case even forces simplicity for free (distinct Newton-polygon valuations, Sheats verified). Sharp structural answer to HOW S3 is satisfied in nature; no zeta realization.
fit.S4: 4/5 — The branch owns the only positivity generators that ever proved an RH: Hodge index/Castelnuovo on the SQUARE X×X (algebraic, Weil) and even-power coefficient positivity (functorial, Deligne), plus self-adjointness (analytic, Selberg — provably insufficient alone). Design rule extracted: the generator always acts on a DOUBLED object, never on the zeta's own explicit formula; Weil positivity over Z is the diagonal shadow of the missing Hodge-index inequality — assuming it is assuming the conclusion, matching the campaign post-mortem.
fit.S5: 3/5 — The anatomy EXPLAINS the no-gos (Bombieri-Garrett cap = Selberg real-segment phenomenon: self-adjointness confines to line ∪ real interval, no further; density ceilings = Ihara ensemble phenomenon; Weil-cone no-gos = diagonal-shadow phenomenon) but survival for zeta itself hinges on a substrate (square of Spec Z, Frobenius tower) that published mathematics does not yet contain.

reports.first_interface: Fix the family B_T = {s : Re s in [0,1], |Im s - T| <= 1}. THEOREM TO PROVE OR REFUTE (the minimal tameness hypothesis under which this branch's tools would begin to see zeros at all): 'There exist a sharply o-minimal structure S and a constant c such that for every T >= 2 the restriction of zeta to B_T is definable in S with format and degree at most c log T.' If true, Peterzil-Starchenko's definable argument principle plus sharp cell decomposition would yield height-uniform, polylog-complexity descriptions of each zero — the entry ticket to any model-theoretic zero-location statement. The referee-evaluable deliverable is the expected NEGATIVE: a quantitative anti-tameness theorem 'Format_S(zeta|B_T) -> infinity for every sharply o-minimal S, with an explicit lower-bound rate', proved from Voronin universality (the T-family of boxes is dense in the zero-free functions on a disc, while S-definable families of bounded format have uniformly bounded topological complexity). Note this interface, even if the positive direction miraculously held, still fails S1: Davenport-Heilbronn satisfies the identical definability hypothesis, so an additional multiplicativity-consuming axiom would have to come from outside the branch — which is why the sharpest available interface is branch-CLOSING rather than branch-connecting.

fit.S1: 3/5 — Supplies the sharpest NEGATIVE calibration of S1 at the axiom level: Beurling worlds have full Euler product, multiplicativity at every prime, and Lambda>=0 pointwise (automatic from the Euler product), yet violate RH maximally (DMV 2006; BDR 2023 [alpha,beta]-systems with beta=1/2+eps, alpha->1) — proving any sufficient S1 input must include functional-equation/duality + integer-structure rigidity, not multiplicativity/positivity alone; but the branch supplies no positive S1 input itself.
fit.S2: 0/5 — Its analytic machinery (Révész/Broucke zero-density under Axiom A) is exactly the density/proportion type that is structurally blind to a single off-line zero; nothing in the branch sees o(N) exceptions.
fit.S3: 0/5 — No multiplicity-visible object exists in the branch; Beurling explicit formulas inherit the Weil-form multiplicity blindness.
fit.S4: 0/5 — The branch generates counterexamples, not positivity; it contains no positivity generator of any sanctioned class.
fit.S5: 5/5 — The branch IS the no-go engine: it produces executable RH-false model worlds for every Euler-product-only axiom set (prescribed-zero-contour zetas, Broucke 2025; discretization machine, Broucke-Vindas 2021), extending and sharpening the program's named no-go list, and its Axiom-A theorems (Riemann-von Mangoldt, Carlson density hold for ALL Beurling systems) constitute an 'RH-insensitivity detector': any lemma provable from Axiom A alone provably cannot decide RH.

key_objects: Beurling zeta zeta_P(s) = prod(1-p^{-s})^{-1} over a generalized prime system; Axiom A (Knopfmacher): N(x)=rho*x+O(x^theta), theta<1 — gives analytic continuation, Riemann-von Mangoldt formula, Carlson zero-density unconditionally (Révész 2012.09045/2209.01689; Révész-Pintz 2407.12746; Broucke 2409.10051) — hence all such machinery is provably RH-insensitive

DMV probabilistic construction (Diamond-Montgomery-Vorhauer, Math. Ann. 334 (2006) 1-36): system with N(x)=rho*x+O(x^theta) (1/2<theta<1), pi(x)=Li(x)+Omega_pm(x exp(-c sqrt(log x))), zeros filling the de la Vallée Poussin boundary — the classical zero-free region is OPTIMAL within Euler-product+integer-density axioms
Zhang 2007 (Math. Ann. 337, 671-704): RH-true systems in the same axiom class — the axioms are RH-undecided in both directions

BDV 2020 (Adv. Math. 370, 107240 / arXiv:2004.11501): pi(x)=Li(x)+O(sqrt x) (RH) coexists with N(x)=rho*x+Omega_pm(x exp(-c sqrt(log x log log x))) — Hilberdink's upper bound sharp; RH does not force integer regularity

[alpha,beta]-systems (Broucke-Debruyne-Révész, arXiv:2309.01567): exist unconditionally for ALL alpha in [0,1), beta in [1/2,1); hard wall max{alpha,beta}>=1/2; beta<1/2 families only under RH — 'RH = Z is the extremal [1/2,0]-system' calibration

Prescribed-zero-contour factory (Broucke, arXiv:2507.13780, Jul 2025): Beurling zetas with infinitely many zeros ON a prescribed contour and none to the right — the plant-a-zero-anywhere machine the program's barrier zoo needs, with matching PNT-error sharpness

Discretization/random-approximation procedure (Broucke-Vindas, arXiv:2102.08478): converts continuous counterexamples to genuine discrete number systems (preserving Lambda_P>=0 pointwise); solved Hilberdink-Neamah and Balazard questions

Lambda>=0-insufficiency corollary (re-derived, elementary): -zeta_P'/zeta_P has nonnegative coefficients for every discrete Beurling system, so 'Lambda(n)>=0 pointwise + Euler product + N(x)=rho*x+O(x^{1/2+eps})' still admits zeros arbitrarily close to Re s=1 — directly relevant to direction C2's claimed S1 input

Kaczorowski-Perelli degree-1 rigidity (Acta Math. 182 (1999) 207-241; Annals 173 (2011) 1397-1441): Selberg class degree 1 = zeta + shifted Dirichlet L only, no elements with 1<d<2 — the closing bracket of the axiom gap from above (FE+Euler product+Ramanujan at degree 1 collapses to actual L-functions)

reports.first_interface: Two-part interface. (A) Degree-one Beurling rigidity theorem (the axiom-gap closure, referee-evaluable, genuinely open): Let P be a discrete Beurling generalized number system whose zeta zeta_P (i) satisfies Axiom A (N_P(x)=rho*x+O(x^theta), theta<1), (ii) extends meromorphically with one simple pole at s=1 and satisfies a degree-one Riemann-type functional equation s <-> 1-s, (iii) has Ramanujan-bounded coefficients. THEOREM TARGET: P is forced to be the rational primes up to the Kaczorowski-Perelli degree-one classification (i.e. zeta_P is zeta or a shifted Dirichlet L) — extending K-P (Acta Math. 1999), whose proof uses ordinary-integer frequencies, to arbitrary Beurling frequencies. This would prove the exact statement every new-branch proposal needs: the S1 input 'Euler product + FE + Ramanujan' is not merely un-counterexampled but RIGID — the axiom gap between Beurling worlds and zeta is precisely the functional equation plus frequency-rigidity, and nothing less (DMV/BDR counterexamples show every weakening fails). (B) Executable corollary for the program NOW (theorem-level, provable from published results): for every axiom subset among {Euler product, Lambda>=0 pointwise, N(x)=rho*x+O(x^{1/2+eps}), Chebyshev, dlVP-PNT} there is an explicit RH-false discrete Beurling system (DMV 2006 + BDR 2023 [alpha,beta] with alpha->1 + Broucke 2025 prescribed contours, discretized via Broucke-Vindas 2021) — institutionalize this as the barrier-zoo falsification suite applied at BRIEF time (completeness-critic gap 7), with the specific new kill: direction C2's 'Lambda(n)>=0 pointwise' input is insufficient even jointly with full multiplicativity and near-RH integer counting.

reports.branch: arithmetic-que-microlocal (arithmetic quantum ergodicity, Eisenstein QUE, entropy/measure-rigidity, microlocal positivity)

fit.S1: 2 — The branch's RH-equivalences (horocycle rate, scattering causality) do consume zeta's automorphy at the AXIOM level (zeta = constant term of the SL2(Z) Eisenstein series, which DH/Epstein lack: DH is not automorphic, Epstein cl>1 is a point-value E(z0,s), not a spectral constant term) — but the branch has NO independent machinery to exploit it: every known proof of a horocycle rate routes back through zeta's own zero data (circular), and QUE technology consumes L-function bounds rather than producing them (verified: subconvexity ⟹ effective QUE, arXiv:2402.14050; quantum-variance direction likewise, arXiv:2311.14184).
fit.S2: 3 — Sarnak-1981-style closed-horocycle asymptotics are a zero-by-zero expansion: a SINGLE off-line zero at beta>1/2 visibly breaks the y^{3/4-eps} rate (contributes ~y^{1-beta/2}), so the STATEMENT is o(N)-sensitive — but only because it is the explicit formula in dynamical clothing; dynamical/ergodic methods themselves (Ratner, effective unipotent, entropy) have never produced any exponent beyond the spectral 1/2 (verified: no 2020-2026 progress toward 3/4 in the closed-horocycle literature).
fit.S3: 2 — In the horocycle expansion an on-line double zero gives a y^{3/4}log(1/y) term while an off-line pair shifts the exponent, so multiplicity is distinguishable in principle — but this visibility is inherited verbatim from the explicit formula, not generated by any branch-specific mechanism; QUE/entropy methods are rate-blind and see neither.
fit.S4: 0 — No positivity generator. The branch's only intrinsic positivity (quantum limits are positive measures) verifiably encodes at most zero-free-region-near-the-1-line strength (Pan-Young arXiv:1910.07164: only zeros NEAR THE 1-LINE distort Eisenstein equidistribution main terms — PNT-strength, not critical-line strength). Sharp Garding/Fefferman-Phong certify positivity only modulo lower-order losses, while RH has zero margin (Rodgers-Tao Lambda>=0: 'barely true'), a structural mismatch; verified NO prior art exists (arXiv full-text search 'Garding inequality'+'Riemann hypothesis' returns 0 results); the viable microlocal-positivity content (Toeplitz/prolate/Sonin) already lives in Connes-Consani's branch, not in eigenfunction technology.
fit.S5: 1 — The branch's spectral corner IS a named S5 no-go: Bombieri-Garrett (arXiv:2002.07929, abstract re-verified this run) caps the pseudo-Laplacian discrete spectrum at ~94% of zeros and notes no reason the discrete spectrum is large at all; the branch's equivalence statements (horocycle rate, Lax-Phillips causality) are Weil-positivity-style reparametrizations; exponent-1/2 rate statements are consistent with the AH world.

reports.first_interface: THEOREM (target, referee-evaluable): There exists eta>0 and a proof by ergodic/dynamical means — using only unipotent-flow technology, Hecke recurrence, and the automorphy of E(z,s), with NO input on the location or density of zeros of zeta beyond its Euler product — that for every f in C_c^infty(SL2(Z)\H), the closed-horocycle averages satisfy m_y(f) = m_0(f) + O_f(y^{1/2+eta}) as y->0. COROLLARY (via the verified Zagier/Sarnak zero-by-zero expansion, each zero beta+i*gamma contributing ~y^{1-beta/2}): zeta(s) has no zeros with beta > 1-2*eta — an unconditional vertical-strip zero-free region, with beta<=1/2 (RH) recovered as eta->1/4. Honest assessment of why this is graded dead-end rather than open: 45+ years of effective-unipotent technology has never beaten the spectral exponent 1/2 on the modular surface (verified through 2026); Verjovsky proved 1/2 optimal for rough observables; and every known spectral proof of any exponent already contains zeta's zeros in the continuous spectrum, so the 'no zeta input' clause excludes all existing proof technology.

reports.first_interface: Theorem (target interface, two referee-evaluable stages). Stage 1 (continuation + functional equation, no positivity): construct a proper analytic stack X over an analytic base B ('the curve' for Q: archimedean and non-archimedean places glued, twistor-P1 at infinity, FF-curves at p) in the Clausen-Scholze formalism, an object E in a six-functor-formalism category D(X) with X → B proper and cohomologically smooth, and an endomorphism Θ, such that the completed zeta function satisfies ξ(s) = det∞(s−Θ | H^1(X,E)) / [det∞(s−Θ | H^0(X,E)) · det∞(s−Θ | H^2(X,E))] as regularized determinants (Deninger's shape, realized by Hesselholt over F_p via TP), with H^0, H^2 producing the s and s−1 poles, and with Poincaré/Serre duality of the formalism inducing the involution s ↔ 1−s — i.e., a six-functor PROOF of meromorphic continuation and the functional equation of ξ. Stage 2 (the RH interface, only meaningful after Stage 1): exhibit a symmetric intersection pairing on H^1(X,E) and an ampleness/Hodge-index theorem for divisors on X ×_B X forcing the Θ-eigenvalue real parts to 1/2, together with a proof that the positivity input is derived from geometry (ampleness on the square) and not a reparametrization of the Weil functional (S4 circularity audit); multiplicity of an eigenvalue must equal dim of its eigenspace (S3), and the formula must fail to exist for Davenport-Heilbronn/Epstein L-functions (S1 axiom-level filter — they are the zeta of no X). Stage 1 alone would be a landmark referee-checkable milestone; nothing in the 2024-2026 corpus claims even Stage 1.

reports.branch: lee-yang-stat-mech

fit.S1: 1/5 — The branch's flagship theorems are provably Euler-blind: Dobner (Acta Arith. 201 (2021), arXiv:2005.05142, verified) proves Newman's conjecture Λ≥0 for the WHOLE extended Selberg class (DH-type functions included), so the dBN/LP framework treats zeta and RH-false lookalikes identically; the only S1-grade input (a prime-factorized ferromagnetic representation of the kernel Φ, which DH's kernel must provably lack since DH violates RH) is an unbuilt hypothetical, not existing machinery.
fit.S2: 4/5 — Lee-Yang is an exact all-zeros mechanism, not a density statement: a valid ferromagnetic realization forces EVERY zero onto the line simultaneously, so a single off-line zero is visible by construction; the score is conditional on the (missing) realization, not on the mechanism.
fit.S3: 3/5 — LP-class membership statements do not distinguish an on-line double from an off-line pair as a certificate signature, but the mechanism dissolves the question rather than failing it: it proves reality of all zeros outright, multiplicities included; no partial/certificate version with multiplicity-visibility exists.
fit.S4: 4/5 — Lee-Yang is explicitly a sanctioned analytic generator and is genuinely NOT Weil positivity in disguise: coupling positivity J_ij≥0 is a strictly-stronger-than-conclusion sufficient condition with its own combinatorial proof engine (Asano contraction/Grace polynomials, Ruelle arXiv:0811.1327, Lieb-Sokal). Docked 1 point because every KNOWN bridge to zeta (Ξ∈LP, Λ=0, Gröchenig's PF criterion, van Dantzig membership) is an RH-EQUIVALENT reformulation — the generator side has never been connected to xi.
fit.S5: 3/5 — Survives most named no-gos (not spectral → Bombieri-Garrett irrelevant; not a mollifier/density method; not a Weil-cone reparametrization; a successful realization would kill the AH world outright). Its own flank is the constraint: Rodgers-Tao Λ≥0 means any Lee-Yang realization of Φ must be EXACTLY critical — zero margin, so all robust/perturbative/approximation-with-slack versions are excluded a priori, and Ki-Kim-Lee-type t>0 results show the entire difficulty concentrates on the boundary t=0.

key_objects: Lee-Yang circle theorem (1952) + Asano contraction + Lieb-Sokal general Lee-Yang theorem: ferromagnetic pair-coupling positivity forces all fugacity-plane zeros onto the unit circle — the branch's positivity GENERATOR (sufficient-condition-shaped, not RH-equivalent)

Newman's Lee-Yang measure class L (measures whose Fourier transforms lie in Laguerre-Polya), closed under convolution and tight weak limits — the closure property that makes 'RH by approximation by finite ferromagnets' a structurally valid strategy (Newman, Proc. AMS 61 (1976))
de Bruijn-Newman kernel Φ and flow H_t; Λ with 0 ≤ Λ ≤ 0.2; RH ⟺ Λ=0 ⟺ Φ(x)dx ∈ L — the branch's canonical zeta interface

Newman 1991 GHS result (Constr. Approx. 7, 389-399, DOI 10.1007/BF01888165, verified): writing Φ=e^{-V}, V' is convex on [0,∞) — the GHS-type NECESSARY condition for Ising-representability of Φ holds; the sufficiency converse is the 35-year-open gap

Knauf number-theoretical spin chain (CMP 153 (1993) 77-115, verified): ζ(s-1)/ζ(s) IS the partition function of a ferromagnetic spin chain in inverse temperature s; Kleban-Özlük Farey fraction spin chain (cond-mat/9808182): ferromagnetic coefficients, proven unique phase transition at β=2 — arithmetic ferromagnets EXIST, but their zeta zeros sit in the temperature (Fisher) variable where no Lee-Yang-type theorem exists

Gröchenig PF criterion (arXiv:2007.12889, published Birkhäuser 2024, full text extracted this run): RH ⟺ ψ = (1/2π)∫ Ξ(τ)^{-1} e^{-iτx} dτ is a Pólya frequency function (Theorems 3-5) — the total-positivity face; author's own assessment: 'no viable expression' for the transform of 1/Ξ, even positive-definiteness of 1/ξ(1/2+·) unknown

Konstantopoulos-Patie-Sarkar van Dantzig framework (arXiv:2211.16680, Ann. Inst. Fourier, verified): common home for the Lee-Yang property and RH inside LP characteristic functions; xi's membership open; one member of xi's van Dantzig pair shown infinitely divisible

Bost-Connes system (partition function ζ(β), SSB at β=1, verified via nLab) and Julia free Riemann gas — realizations where the Euler product = independence over primes, but zeros live beyond the region where the product representation converges
Rodgers-Tao Λ≥0 (arXiv:1801.05914) + Dobner extended-Selberg-class generalization — the branch's own no-margin and Euler-blindness theorems

Michalowski certified PF₅ failure of Φ (arXiv:2602.20313, verified): explicit 5×5 Toeplitz minor rigorously negative; plus the one-line Schoenberg observation (this run) that Φ could NEVER be PF∞ since its Laplace transform Ξ has zeros while PF transforms are reciprocals of zero-free LP functions — cleanly separating the (dead) 'Φ is PF' route from the (open, RH-equivalent) 'ψ=F⁻¹(1/Ξ) is PF' route

AMS 61: Λ well-defined, conjectured Λ≥0; Lee-Yang measure class L and its closure properties) — the strategy template ('approximate Φ within L') stands; died operationally: no arithmetic ferromagnet approximating Φ was ever produced. [RECALLED-classical; conjecture resolution verified]

Approx. 7, 389-399 [VERIFIED: Springer 10.1007/BF01888165 + NYU publication list] — proved V'=(−log Φ)' convex on [0,∞), i.e. the GHS-type necessary condition for Φ to be an Ising total-spin distribution HOLDS; died: necessary-condition progress only, no sufficiency mechanism; untouched since.

Successor Farey-chain line (Kleban-Özlük 1998 [VERIFIED], Fiala-Kleban 2004, Bandtlow-Fiala-Kleban-Prellberg 2009, Technau arXiv:2304.08143 [VERIFIED]) proved the β=2 transition and free-energy asymptotics but ZERO partition-function-zero results; effectively dormant as an RH route.

reports.first_interface: Prime-factorized Lee-Yang representation of the Riemann kernel. Let Φ be the de Bruijn-Newman kernel, so Ξ(z)=∫Φ(x)e^{izx}dx and RH ⟺ Ξ ∈ Laguerre-Pólya. THEOREM (target): For each finite set of primes P there exists an even probability measure μ_P in Newman's Lee-Yang class L — realized explicitly as the total-spin distribution of a finite ferromagnetic Ising system (single-site even measures, pair couplings J_ij ≥ 0) whose data are constructed from the Euler factors {(1-p^{-s})^{-1}: p ∈ P} — together with a uniform sub-Gaussian tail bound sup_P μ_P({|x|>R}) ≤ Ce^{-cR²}, such that μ_P → Φ(x)dx/∫Φ weakly as P exhausts the primes. COROLLARY (via Newman's closure of L under tight weak limits): Ξ ∈ LP, i.e. RH. Referee checks: (i) μ_P ∈ L by the circle theorem/Asano contraction — pure stat mech; (ii) the tail bound — explicit; (iii) weak convergence to Φ — Fourier-analytic; (iv) S1/DH-filter audit: identify the exact step that consumes multiplicativity, verified by confirming the construction has no analogue for the Davenport-Heilbronn kernel (whose measure provably lies outside L since DH violates RH). Any proof must be exactly critical (Rodgers-Tao Λ≥0 forbids margin), so no perturbative slack may be claimed anywhere.

BUT it is a theorem-shaped target, not ready-made machinery: the decisive object — the square with an intersection theory — is Connes' own named missing step (verified quote, essay 1509.05576 §4.3.2), stalled 8 years. Demotions applied: the load-bearing non-circularity claim (function-field Hodge index proven independently of RH via RR+ampleness) is recalled_unverified and must be re-derived before design; the program brief's 'GRR over Spec Z' paraphrase of 2606.06604 is unconfirmed, and the f1 scout's full-text check found NO square-level structure in that paper.

synthesis.sweep_verdict: No Grossmann. The sweep's decisive finding is that the generator exists but the geometry does not. The only positivity mechanism that has ever proved an RH — Hodge index/Castelnuovo on the square of a curve, run through Deligne's even-power amplification — is published, understood, and confirmed by the comparative-anatomy scout as the unique historical success; but its substrate over Q (a square of Spec Z with intersection theory, equivalently a Weil cohomology with derived positivity) exists in no branch. The two programs building it are stalled at exactly that step: Connes–Consani have the curve, Jacobian, and Riemann-Roch (2023-2026) but not the square (Connes' own named missing ingredient, 8 years); Deninger has the phase space (2024) and — new — both model-world halves proven as theorems in 2024 (ALKL trace formula, regularized-determinant formula), but no cohomology on the actual arithmetic object, and his own no-go (no real-coefficient Weil cohomology) bounds shortcuts. Everything else fails the spec: five branches are certified dead ends, and the remaining machinery is estimate-level (o(N)-blind), equivalence-level (Weil positivity reparametrized — the campaign post-mortem held up across the entire sweep), or ensemble-level (blind to the one deterministic configuration). So the program proceeds to de novo construction — Weil mode — but with its raw material fixed by the sweep: axioms from the functorial/motivic package (RS-nonnegativity, the sweep's only S1=5; Λ-ring descent; weight purity), target inequality Castelnuovo-on-the-square with the S6 amendment (finite-rank/tower rationality + doubled object) added to the spec, calibration theorems Beurling degree-one rigidity and the automorphic edge-cap adjudication, and substrate candidates the CC square, Deninger's Witt space, and the condensed archimedean FF-curve. Before design, run three cheap decisive tests that could still expose a Grossmann hiding inside the live third-party programs: the CCM DH-filter (finite-dimensional), the 2606.06604 body read, and the Fuchs margin-law recomputation. The one new direction the critic requested should be a single joint geometric-substrate direction (arakelov + deninger via the Morishita bridge), while the certified-computation arm stands up as the only channel that could decide RH — negatively — within the horizon. The sweep closes when the unswept corners above are scouted or justified.
